source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Use Ireasoning MIB browser professional:
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Open Ireasoning MIB browser, load the MIB files.
4. Setup the settings of MIB browser to access BMC according to the WEB UI SNMPv3 settings.
5. Left-click on the $target and expand subtree.
6. Right-Click on the node and use "Get Next" or "Get Subtree" to get all the values of the $target.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Use NetSNMP to check.
1. Enable SNMP v3 agent settings from WEB UI. (Refer to WebGUI spec/user guide).
2. Enable the corresponding user account SNMPv3 settings at WEB UI.
3. Put the mib files into the netsnmp search path.
http://www.net-snmp.org/docs/FAQ.html#Where_should_I_put_my_MIB_files_
4. Use NetSNMP "get type" of command(s) to retrieve the values of the $target from BMC.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: snmpwalk (net-snmp), BMC SNMP agent must be enabled + community configured
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- SNMP "monitor_disks" monitoring reads specific BMC MIB data via the SNMP agent; from a 2nd management host run `snmpwalk -v2c -c ${SNMP_COMMUNITY:?operator must set SNMP community (v2c) or v3 creds} "$BMC_IP" .1.3.6.1.4.1.8072.2.3.2.1.2 | grep -i disks (or walk the vendor MIB subtree once the SNMP community/v3 creds + MIB are configured). Enable + point SNMP agent first.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL snmpwalk output for the disk/FRU OID subtree so the user confirms the monitor_disks SNMP data is correct.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: SNMP queries need a management host + enabled/configured SNMP agent on the BMC (community/v3 + firewall); enabling SNMP is a config change, and some BMC SNMP sets expose credentials - use read-only community.

original_test_intent: Retrieve an approved storage inventory/health view over SNMPv3 and compare physical/logical identities and states to the platform baseline.
original_method: Engineer enables v3 and browses `$target`; neither source nor Criteria defines whether disks mean FRUs, drives, arrays or OS devices.
manual_activity: Engineer configures WebUI/v3; read-only inventory can be automated after the storage layer and objects are defined.
safety_requirements: Read only; never reset, remove, blink, initialize or write a disk.
Protect v3 secrets and storage identifiers.
Do not substitute v2c/generic grep or conflate FRU with drive health.
No automatic retry or remedial storage action.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, query exact objects and reconcile serial/slot/status to approved topology.
Do not mutate storage or issue verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic v2c grep cannot establish whether returned entries are disks, FRUs or health records.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use exact vendor storage OIDs and preserve full tables with redacted identifiers.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IReasoning, `$target`, Net-SNMP criterion and 10/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Define one storage layer, query its identity/status table over v3, and reconcile with controller/Redfish/OS evidence without writes.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor storage MIB and status-enum documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds layer, identity and state mapping.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents FRU presence from being misreported as drive health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC inventory may lag controller state.

project_override_considerations: Project may select physical drives or logical volumes, but must state the layer and cannot claim the omitted layer.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: `disks` is undefined, IReasoning and Net-SNMP methods differ, and DeepSeek labels the result disk/FRU while changing to v2c.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Storage layer/OIDs/baseline are project inputs; after manual SNMPv3 setup, bounded read-only inventory is automatable.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Block is source object ambiguity, not missing client/MIB package alone.

review_improvement: Requires storage-layer identity and prohibits follow-on writes.
independent_technical_reasoning: A FRU record, physical drive and logical volume are distinct. Without specifying one, matching a word such as disk produces neither reliable coverage nor safe diagnostic meaning.
